industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: ONE Nuclear Energy Inc. Common Stock
summary: ONE Nuclear Energy Inc. provides large-scale energy development, ownership, and operation of integrated power generation platforms using fast-track natural gas and advanced nuclear small modular reactor (SMR) technologies. It offers development; construction; ownership and operation of utility-scale natural gas power plants; deployment of factory-built SMRs; turnkey energy parks for customers, such as data centers, hydrogen production, industrial manufacturing, and utilities; and long-term power purchase agreements and offtake structures. It serves AI and data centers, hydrogen production, industrial manufacturing, utilities and grid operators, government and infrastructure, and sustainability-driven enterprises. The company is based in West Palm Beach, Florida.
